pr_title: log backup: fix the issue that paused service safepoint not removed
pr_body:

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/52082

Problem Summary:
stop task didn't remove service safepoint correctly.

### What changed and how does it work?
1. set ttl == 0 to make pd service remove this safepoint.

issue_context.title: GC safepoint not moving forward after log backup stopped
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)
1. start log backup and pause it.
2. stop log backup.
3. check the service-gc-safepoint via pd-ctl.

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
no br related service-gc-safepoint.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
![23bc4553-be67-44fa-bd5c-29ff99a3fcad](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/assets/5906259/0284291c-c2da-46bd-a355-af85c2b3c47b)

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->

review_comments: If I recall right we remove the safepoint by setting the ts to zero before. Will set TTL to zero work?
yes, and if set ts to 0. it won't pass the check before connect to pd to remove this safepoint.
